sat.detail: Partly sunny, high near 86, south wind ~6 mph. Tonight mostly cloudy, low ~68, 10% precip.

sun.short: Patchy fog, then chance showers and thunderstorms
sun.detail: Patchy AM fog then chance of showers/thunderstorms, mostly cloudy, high near 82, gusts to 21 mph, 40% precip. Sunday night showers/storms likely, 80%, quarter-to-half inch.

weather.verdict: Saturday is the outdoor day. Sunday = indoor/backup plans after morning.

attractions.name: Ricketts Glen State Park (Falls Trail)
attractions.note: 22 named waterfalls; Falls Trail ~7.2-mi loop. No closures posted on park page. Do it SATURDAY - wet rock after Sunday storms is treacherous. ~45 min from Kingston.

attractions.name: Frances Slocum State Park
attractions.price: Park free; pool charges a fee
attractions.note: Closest state park to 18704 (~15 min). Pool w/ 2 waterslides open daily 11-7 through Labor Day per DCNR swimming page; 165-acre lake, kayaking, trails.

attractions.name: Seven Tubs Recreation Area
attractions.note: Glacial potholes + waterfalls on Wheelbarrow Run. Only 59 parking spots - lot fills by ~11am summer Saturdays; go early. Gate closes when lot is full.

attractions.name: Nescopeck State Park
attractions.note: Quiet 3,550-acre park, flat wetland/forest trails, environmental education center. Good low-crowd alternative.

attractions.name: D&L Trail - Black Diamond section (White Haven trailhead)
attractions.note: Crushed-stone rail-trail along the Lehigh; ride south toward Lehigh Gorge. ~30 min from Kingston.

attractions.name: Back Mountain Trail
attractions.address: Trailhead off Parry Street, Luzerne, PA 18709
attractions.note: Rail-trail climbing from Luzerne toward Trucksville/Dallas; closest bike trail to 18704.

attractions.name: Wyoming Valley Levee Trail (Kirby Park access)
attractions.address: Kirby Park, Market Street, Wilkes-Barre/Kingston, PA 18704
attractions.note: Paved/gravel riverside miles atop the Susquehanna flood levee, flat, right in Kingston - the zero-drive option.

attractions.name: Harveys Lake public access (PFBC boat launch)
attractions.address: Lakeside Drive (Rt 415 NW corner), Harveys Lake, PA 18618
attractions.note: Only true public access on the lake - two paved ramps, parking, restrooms. Shoreline/swimming otherwise private (Sunset Beach Club is members/private).

attractions.name: Mohegan Pennsylvania (casino + harness racing)
attractions.note: Sat Aug 1: 'Stars, Stripes and Jeeps Saturdays' Jeep Wrangler giveaway, live harness racing, free line dancing at Embers Terrace. Sun: Play & Eat Sundays, champagne brunch at The Hive.

attractions.name: Steamtown National Historic Site
attractions.price: Museum FREE; Scranton Limited train ride $6 (ages 6+), $1 under 6
attractions.note: Scranton Limited short train rides BOTH days: 10:30, 11:30, 1:15, 2:30. SPECIAL SAT AUG 1: NEPA Wine Train, 1pm from Carbondale (Iron Horse Society, $25-55). Roundhouse + working steam yard.

attractions.name: Electric City Trolley Museum
attractions.note: Vintage trolley excursions run Thu-Sun; museum daily 9-4:30. Same campus as Steamtown - easy double-header.
